I'm a data modernization consultant working toward a career in data engineering. I graduated from the University of British Columbia in May 2025 with a major in **Statistics** and a minor in **Data Science**, including a semester at the University of Oslo.

Day to day I work with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI in Python, R, SQL and DAX. I'm interested in data engineering, Azure consulting, and analytics and experimentation roles.

My statistics background shows up in my work: I've done a research consulting capstone, a research assistantship in climate extremes, and hackathons where we shipped under pressure. Outside of work, I enjoy running, climbing, and crocheting.

I hold [many technical certifications](certifications.qmd), including Power BI, Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake.
